Annual Time Series from an MSE

Source: R/performance_metrics.R
Extract_MSE_Timeseries.Rd

Per-simulation annual time series for the historical and projection periods: spawning biomass relative to the equilibrium unfished spawning biomass SB0 (SB_SB0; SB0 is constant over years) and to SBMSY (SB_SBMSY), fishing mortality relative to FMSY (F_FMSY) and, if FTarget_FMSY is supplied, to the F target (F_FTarget), and catch (Yield, removals summed over stocks and fleets).

Usage

Extract_MSE_Timeseries(MSE, Stock = "Female", FTarget_FMSY = NULL)

Arguments

MSE

An mse object.

Stock

Character. Name of the spawning stock. Default 'Female'.

FTarget_FMSY

Numeric. The F target relative to FMSY, for each simulation or a single value (see Calc_FTarget_FMSY()). Default NULL (no F_FTarget).

Value

A data.frame with columns Sim, Year, Period, MP, Value, and Variable. Historical rows have MP = 'Historical'.

Details

Ratios are averaged over the seasons of each calendar year (fishing mortality is an annual rate in each season) and catch is summed.
